neighbours.label: the comma at which a run-on sentence splices a second independent clause onto the first (comma splice), as against commas inside a single clause
fire: The singer has been linked to the role for years, the studio would never confirm it.
Our neighbour is not a trained electrician, he cannot be trusted with the wiring.
The old bridge was mentioned as a possible landmark many times, the council would give it some kind of plaque.
My brother is not a morning person, it cannot be expected that he will cook breakfast.
The company was named as a likely buyer over the summer, the bank would offer it some sort of loan.
That dog is not a guard animal, it cannot be left alone with the chickens.
The striker was tipped as a future captain for seasons, the club would hand him a long contract.
Her essay is not a finished draft, it cannot be submitted on Friday.
